title: CLINB: A Climate Intelligence Benchmark for Foundational Models

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting ablation studies on the LLM autorater prompts (e.g., removing specific rubrics) to observe if the judge model inappropriately favors LLM-generated text over human-curated hybrid answers.

Comparing autorater results using vanilla prompts versus rigorous, expert-curated rubrics to determine if the LLM judge or human raters favor stylistic presentation and formatting over substantive factual correctness.

Analyzing evaluation discordance between different human rater groups (Experts vs. Scientists) to identify if raters favor specific model outputs (e.g., Gemini) due to overexposure during the earlier data curation phases.
Swapping the presentation order of candidate answers in model-based pairwise side-by-side (SxS) evaluations to control for and mitigate the judge model's tendency to favor the first-presented answer.
